newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lepanto says finds new gold deposit.
newsitem.headline: Lepanto says finds new gold deposit.

text.p: Lepanto Consolidated Mining Co said on Wednesday it had found a new gold mineral deposit, with ore reserves estimated at 3.2 million tonnes.

"In the course of the company's ongoing exploration work, (it) has found a gold mineral deposit near its Tubo shaft area," Lepanto president Artemio Disini said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange
The firm did not state the location of its new found gold mine.
"The gold mineralization is classified as vein type with seven zones already identified," the statement said.
"On the basis of the data derived from 25 drill holes and underground openings, the ore reserves are estimated to be about 3.2 million tonnes," Disini said.
Lepanto is doing more exploration work on the site to determine the extent of the gold deposit in the area, Disini said.
A feasibility study will also be made by the company to determine the commercial viability of the deposit, he added.
Shares of Lepanto remained unchanged at 17 centavos in late Manila trade.
